name: color-separation
comment: The 2026-08-26 pass's CPU-and-uploads app (numpy/scipy/Pillow halftone separation, Django 6, SQLite, FileResponse downloads). Serve from the checkout with its venv on PATH: `m0serve halftone_studio.wsgi --max-body 64m` (or .asgi). A clean clone CANNOT run it: the `output/` source package is gitignored (see the design doc); copy it from a working tree. Needs one processed job (id 1): upload an image on /, then POST the settings form to /job/1/process/ with n_colors <= 6 -- the form's own default of 8 fails spot mode's validator. The uploads block posts the real multipart form (CSRF from /), and `follow` requires the job page the 302 lands on to exist.

routes.comment: answers 500 on a completed job -- an application bug (int64 is not JSON serializable), deterministic, so it is compared like any route
the same zip through Django's media serving
the 9.7 MB original, larger than every buffer
